injured.title: Injured troops

injured.noMedicine: Research Medicine so that some of the troops this city loses, defending or attacking, survive injured (5% per level, up to 50%).
injured.healInfo: Heal them for {{percent}} of their training cost, or for honour ({{honor}} available).

dismiss.troopsInfo: Dismissed troops leave the army for good and rejoin the population.

dismiss.noRefund: You get back nothing: no training cost is left to give back for these.
